text: Dropped off four rusty wheels and picked up what looked like brand new rims. The gloss black powder coat is perfect and the price was fair.
They blasted and powder coated the frame of my 1970s motorcycle. Every weld and corner is covered and the finish is like glass. Couldn't be happier.
Our patio furniture was rusted through in spots. After a trip to Hespeler Powder Coating it looks better than the day we bought it.
Needed a custom bracket made and the part coated to match. The on-site machinist sorted it the same week. One shop for the whole job saved me a ton of running around.
Great quality work on my truck bumper and hitch. Took a little longer than quoted because of a busy week, but they kept me posted and the finish is excellent.
Dry ice blasting took decades of grime off my engine block without damaging anything. I didn't know that was even possible. Impressive equipment and knowledgeable people.
Brought in a pile of old iron railings. They came back stripped, coated in matte black and ready to install. Very professional and easy to deal with.
I restore classic cars and finding a shop that can blast a whole chassis and coat it properly is hard. The walk-in blast room makes it easy. They are my go-to now.
Beautiful job on a set of vintage bike parts. The candy red is stunning in the sun. Only wish I'd known to ask about clear coat sooner, but they helped me pick the right finish.
Fast turnaround and honest pricing. They told me which of my parts weren't worth coating and saved me money. That kind of honesty is rare.
Had a fireplace screen and a set of gates done. The powder coat has held up through a full Ontario winter with no chips or fading. Worth every penny.
The finish on my lawn chairs came out nice, but pickup was delayed twice. They apologized and took a bit off the price. Quality is good, communication could be better.
Glass blasting cleaned up my old cast iron cookware and tools better than I ever could by hand. Friendly team who clearly love what they do.
Used them for a batch of parts for my small business. Consistent colour on every piece, delivered on time, and they were happy to handle repeat orders. Highly recommend for commercial work.
My ATV frame and swingarm came back looking factory fresh, better actually. Hundreds of colours to pick from and the finish feels incredibly tough.
Good people and great results on my aluminum boat trailer. The blast got into every crevice. Booked a bit in advance but it was worth the wait.
I'm picky about finishes and they listened. We tested a couple of samples before choosing satin charcoal for my kitchen stool bases. They look amazing.
Local, friendly and incredibly skilled. They took a tired set of garage shelving brackets and an old mailbox post and made them look new. The whole family is impressed.
The colour was slightly different from the sample I picked, and I had to ask for a redo. They did fix it, but it added a week to my project.
Quote was fair, communication was great, and the powder coating on my wheelbarrow-sized fire pit is flawless. I've already sent two neighbours their way.
Stripped paint, rust and decades of neglect off an old tractor seat and fender. The results are unreal. If it's metal, these folks can make it look great.
Excellent powder coating on my set of motorcycle rims. A couple of tiny spots needed a touch-up but they handled it right away with no fuss.
Walked in with a rusty gate and walked out with a happy customer. Honest advice, clean shop and a finish that has lasted. Will be back for the next project.
They handled a rush job for me on a short deadline and still did it right. The machine shop was able to fix a bent mounting plate on the spot. Lifesavers.
